description: Read-only. Checks the whole integration now (GET /v1/app/verify) and returns each check as pass / warn / fail / unknown / skip with a plain-words fix: android_app, ios_app, app_file.<android|ios>.<host> (the files fetched live), sdk_connected (the app has reported and something arrived in the last 24 hours), sdk_current[.<platform>.<version>], link_opens and webhooks. ok is true only when nothing failed and nothing is unknown. Work through every check that is not pass and not skip: apply its fix, then call this again. Run it after any change to the app IDs, the signing key, the SDK or the app's link handling. A warn on app_file saying the file still has older app details means wait 10 minutes and check again; unknown means it could not check just now (try again in a minute). At most 6 calls a minute per workspace. Needs a read or full secret key.
name: verify_app_setup
title: Check the app setup
